verdict.rationale: cubic documents cross-repo reviews: you link related repositories so a review can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work across them. That is its own way of giving broader multi-project context. However, it is scoped to PR reviews rather than a user-assembled session where you add multiple project directories, and the docs are thin. Missing for 10: adding multiple local project directories to a single chat/CLI session, details on how linked-repo context is used and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context

citations.quote: Link related repositories so reviews can check shared APIs, schemas, docs, or release work.
Cross-repo reviews help cubic catch changes that need a matching update in another repository.
